metadata.name: liquidity_facility
metadata.description: NAV-collateralized advances underwritten at MARK_PROTECTIVE, maintenance health checks, no liquidation on a stale mark, and the liquidation ladder issuer ROFR -> backstop -> forced-sale auction -> workout (SRS 08 §4.5, LF-P1..P6). Audit-scope-critical.

instructions.name: check_health
docs: LF-P3: debt over value at `MARK_PROTECTIVE` against the maintenance
LTV. Breach starts the grace clock; a healthy reading cures it.
Permissionless.

instructions.name: ladder_buy
docs: LF-P5 steps 1–2: the issuer (at `MARK_PROTECTIVE`) or the backstop
(at its contracted haircut) buys the whole collateral. The price
repays the rails advance first; the surplus goes to the borrower; a
shortfall is booked. Remaining accounts: rails `Repay` list.

instructions.name: list_forced_sale
docs: LF-P5 step 3b: list the whole collateral as the session's ask at the
lowest limit (a forced sale has no reserve). The caller funds the
ask bond. Remaining accounts: rails `OpenAssetVault` (8), then the
auction-engine `Commit` list (3) and its rails `DepositAsk` list (13).

instructions.name: open_facility
docs: LF-P2: open a facility and its rails fund (curator = signer PDA).
Remaining accounts: rails `OpenFacility` list + the signer's
`EngineGrant`.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, to locate its ProgramData. Opening a facility makes the signer its authority and lets it drive the rails through this program's single granted signer PDA, so it is a governance act.

instructions.name: open_forced_sale
docs: LF-P5 step 3a: open the forced-sale auction session (the signer PDA
is the venue's forced-sale opener). Remaining accounts: the
auction-engine `OpenSession` list followed by its rails list.

instructions.name: pass_step
docs: LF-P5: pass the current step — its buyer declines, or anyone once
its window has closed. ROFR → backstop → forced sale.

instructions.name: pledge_and_advance
docs: LF-P1: pledge `qty` of the asset and draw `amount` USDC. Remaining
accounts: rails `AdvanceFunds` list.

instructions.name: reveal_forced_sale
docs: LF-P5 step 3c: reveal the forced-sale ask (permissionless, inside
the reveal window). Remaining accounts: the auction-engine `Reveal`
list followed by its rails list.

instructions.name: settle_forced_sale
docs: LF-P5 steps 3d + 4: once the forced-sale session has printed (or
failed) and the rails have refunded the ask escrow, apply the
proceeds (advance first, surplus to the borrower, shortfall booked)
and assign any unsold collateral to the lender's workout account.
Remaining accounts: rails `Repay` list.

instructions.name: start_liquidation
docs: LF-P4/P5: past the grace window and still breached at a Fresh or
Warned mark, the ladder starts at the issuer's ROFR. Permissionless.

errors.name: AdvanceRateAboveCeiling

errors.msg: feed or mint does not match the facility

types.name: Advance
docs: One borrower's advance from one facility (LF-P1/P6).

fields.name: facility
docs: Facility (`has_one`).

fields.name: borrower
docs: Borrower (the pledging claim holder).

fields.name: collateral_ref_hash
docs: Hash of the pledged collateral reference (claim / lot id).

fields.name: collateral_value
docs: Collateral mark the advance was sized against (micro-USDC), as
supplied by the curator (#94). There is no mark engine yet, so the
rails cannot verify it; they bound the advance by it.

fields.name: advance_rate_bps
docs: Advance rate the curator applied, in bps; at most the H1 ceiling
`credit_math::MAX_ADVANCE_RATE_BPS` (#94). Original principal ≤
`collateral_value × advance_rate_bps / 10⁴`.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal still owed.

fields.name: interest
docs: Interest accrued and not yet paid.

fields.name: last_accrual
docs: Last accrual time.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: Facility
docs: A liquidity-facility fund (LF-P1/P2): USDC in a program-owned vault,
lent out as advances to registered destinations only.

fields.name: curator
docs: Curator key (the liquidity-facility engine's signer; underwriting —
advance rate vs `MARK_PROTECTIVE` — happens there, not here).

fields.name: facility_id
docs: Curator-chosen id; part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Settlement mint snapshot.

fields.name: vault
docs: Vault token account (`["facility_vault", facility]`).

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Simple APR in bps (pilot: 1_200 = 12%), ≤ `MAX_RATE_BPS`.

fields.name: principal_outstanding
docs: Principal currently lent out across live advances.

fields.name: total_funded
docs: Lifetime cash in from funders.

fields.name: interest_collected
docs: Lifetime interest collected.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: rails_facility
docs: payment-rails `Facility` (curator = this program's signer PDA).

fields.name: feed
docs: mark-engine feed of the collateral.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Interest APR (rails `rate_bps`, ≤ rails `MAX_RATE_BPS`).

fields.name: advance_rate_bps
docs: Curator advance rate (≤ H1 `MAX_ADVANCE_RATE_BPS`).

fields.name: maintenance_ltv_bps
docs: Breach when debt / value exceeds this (> advance rate, ≤ 100%).

fields.name: grace_seconds
docs: Top-up window between breach and the ladder (LF-P3).

fields.name: issuer
docs: Ladder step 1: the issuer (ROFR at MARK_PROTECTIVE).

fields.name: backstop
docs: Ladder step 2: the pre-registered backstop bidder.

fields.name: forced_sale_max_cash
docs: Ladder step 3: per-investor cash cap of the forced-sale session.

fields.name: lender_workout
docs: Ladder step 4: owner of the lender's workout asset account.

fields.name: print_source
docs: auction-engine's print PDA (the only `record_print` signer).

fields.name: nav_pico
docs: Latest official NAV at [`NAV_SCALE`] (0 = never published).

fields.name: effective_ts
docs: When the NAV was written on-chain; ages are measured from here.

fields.name: last_drill
docs: The latest NAV came from `publish_drill_nav`.

fields.name: last_state
docs: Last evented state (transitions are evented once).

fields.name: implied_pico
docs: Implied NAV from the latest eligible print (0 = none).

fields.name: warn_after
docs: Age at which a Fresh mark becomes Warned.

fields.name: stale_after
docs: Age at which the mark becomes Stale.

fields.name: warned_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Warned (≤ `MAX_WARNED_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: stale_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Stale or Suspended (≤ `MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: band_bps
docs: BANDED width, bps of price.

fields.name: min_print_volume
docs: Minimum print volume (base units) to enter the implied curve.

fields.name: min_print_investors
docs: Minimum distinct investor_ids on a print (G2).

fields.name: outlier_band_bps
docs: Maximum |print − NAV| / NAV for an eligible print.

fields.name: drills_enabled
docs: Devnet only: allow `publish_drill_nav` (AC-9 drill). Fixed at
`initialize_feed`.

fields.name: rofr
docs: Issuer ROFR fill (settled at exercise).

fields.name: position
docs: The borrower of the position.

types.name: MarkState
docs: ME-P2 mark states. `Suspended` is set only by `suspend`. `Frozen`
(appended, #202) is age > 3× cadence (06 §4).

fields.name: escrowed
docs: Cash (buy) or asset (sell) escrowed in the rails at commit.

fields.name: alloc
docs: Allocation at the clearing price.

fields.name: alloc_left
docs: Allocation not yet paired into a fill (AE-P6 cursor).

fields.name: screened
docs: AE-P6: the gate check ran on this order.

fields.name: eligible
docs: AE-P6: it passed; only eligible orders clear.

types.name: Phase
docs: AE-P2 phases (06 §2).

fields.name: qty
docs: Collateral held (0 once sold, released or worked out).

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Liquidation proceeds (owner = signer PDA).

fields.name: step_deadline
docs: Current ladder step's deadline.

fields.name: shortfall
docs: Debt left after the ladder (non-recourse).

fields.name: listed
docs: LF-P5: quantity listed in the forced sale (its seasoned part).

types.name: PrintPolicy
docs: ME-P6 print policy classes.

fields.name: feed
docs: mark-engine feed of the asset.

fields.name: rails_session
docs: payment-rails `CashSession` (operator = this program's PDA).

types.name: SessionParams
docs: AE-P1: everything snapshotted at open; immutable afterwards.

fields.name: rofr_window
docs: ROFR window length after `reveal_end` (0 with no ROFR authority).

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: Hard deadline: settlement closes, every escrow refundable.

fields.name: bond
docs: Forfeitable bond per order (micro-USDC).

fields.name: max_cash
docs: Per-investor cash cap (micro-USDC).

fields.name: min_reveals
docs: Fewer revealed orders than this ⇒ Failed (G13).

fields.name: max_discount_bps
docs: Reserve floor = NAV_effective × (1 − max_discount_bps).

fields.name: forced_sale
docs: AE-P11: opened by the facility; no reserve; flagged print.

fields.name: rofr_authority
docs: Issuer ROFR authority; `Pubkey::default()` disables ROFR.

fields.name: disclosure_hash
docs: Hash of the session disclosure, carried on every transfer record.
